title: MVR-Data
description: An Arrow-based runtime organization, interchange format, and Python toolkit for multi-vector retrieval data.

chapters.title: Welcome Page & How to Use MVR-Data
chapters.description: Install the toolkit, create raw or embedded data packages, read and validate them, and prepare archives for distribution.

chapters.title: Schema Implementation
chapters.description: How schema.py defines the canonical Arrow representation for objects, vectors, components, and relevance judgments.

chapters.title: Manifest Implementation
chapters.description: How manifest.py creates, normalizes, validates, loads, and atomically writes package metadata.

chapters.title: Writer Implementation
chapters.description: How writer.py constructs safe raw and embedded packages while enforcing IDs, vector shapes, sharding, and ground-truth invariants.

chapters.title: Reader Implementation
chapters.description: How reader.py resolves trusted shard paths and streams schema-checked Arrow record batches.

chapters.title: Validation Implementation
chapters.description: How validation.py reports structural, semantic, referential, judgment, and optional detailed-integrity errors.

chapters.title: Checksum Implementation
chapters.description: How checksums.py creates and verifies deterministic whole-package SHA-256 integrity records.

chapters.title: Packaging Implementation
chapters.description: How packaging.py creates reproducible tar.zst archives and rejects unsafe content during extraction.

chapters.title: CLI & Public API Implementation
chapters.description: How cli.py, __init__.py, and pyproject.toml expose the reference implementation to scripts and terminal workflows.
